sources.title: Global River Forecasting with a Topology-Informed AI Foundation Model
sources.snippet: However, widespread hydrology data scarcity often restricts data-driven forecasting to isolated predictions. To achieve systemic simulation and reduce reliance on river observations, we present GraphRiverCast (GRC), a topology-informed AI foundation model designed to simulate multivariate river hydrodynamics in global river systems.

sources.title: GitHub - HeQinWill/awesome-WeatherAI: A curated list of awesome ...
sources.snippet: This repository contains a curated list of papers, datasets, models, surveys, and other resources related to using AI for weather forecasting and climate modeling. It includes key papers that have advanced the state-of-the-art in areas like global forecasting, precipitation prediction, and climate projection using deep learning techniques.
